title: Data Ingestion & Integrity Review
description: Verify that raw data feeds and providers adhere to no-leakage and metadata-only rules.
action_required: Review data contracts and verify zero scraping.

title: Feature & Factor Quality Review
description: Verify that features and factors have no lookahead bias and are non-signal.

title: Regime Engine & Transitions Review
description: Verify regime definitions, stability, and absence of target labels.
action_required: Review transition matrices and stability metrics.

title: ML Governance & Model Cards Review
description: Verify that all model metadata, calibration, and drift checks are non-executing.
action_required: Inspect model cards and explainability attribution.

title: Backtest Acceptance Layer Review
description: Verify realistic slippage, transaction cost modeling, and OOS validation.
action_required: Review walk-forward and Monte Carlo robustness summaries.

title: Portfolio Acceptance Block Review
description: Verify portfolio construction and optimization constraints.
action_required: Review weight allocation bounds and diversification.

title: Risk Limits & Exposure Attribution Review
description: Verify risk exposure attribution and limit monitoring contracts.
action_required: Inspect risk budget allocations and limit warnings.

title: Scenario Testing & Drawdown Control Review
description: Verify stress scenarios, historical shocks, and drawdown controls.
action_required: Review derisking triggers and recovery simulations.

title: Reporting Layer & Documentation Review
description: Verify that reports contain all mandatory disclaimers and warnings.
action_required: Inspect markdown and txt reports for compliance.

title: Phase 159 Release Candidate Review Gate
description: Final human gate before proceeding to Phase 159 Release Candidate preparation.
action_required: Confirm all 9 preceding gates are verified.
